R1.description: The determinism test runs its two complete passes at the same time, each on its own clone, with unchanged assertions and unchanged fail-closed rules

R2.description: A failure of either pass fails the test only after both have finished, and the helper has tests of overlap, order and failure

R3.description: The speed-up is measured on four CPUs and is at least 30%, else the plan is amended

R4.description: The CI guide and the roadmap state the new behaviour and #126 done
